data.title: Clarity Act’s failure gave crypto ‘faster’ regulatory wins, Bitwise CIO says
data.summary_raw: Bitwise’s Matt Hougan says Clarity’s defeat left crypto with fewer restrictions and faster SEC action.

data.title: CFTC secures over $30 million judgment against defendants in Fundsz fraud case
data.summary_raw: The CFTC secured a win in court after the agency said two defendants participated in a crypto scheme that they then tried to walk back.

data.title: Base launches Cobalt upgrade with conditional transactions and new B20 asset functions
data.summary_raw: Base has launched Cobalt, adding conditional transactions and new functions for assets issued under its B20 standard.

data.title: DogeOS launches testnet to bring EVM smart contracts to Dogecoin
data.summary_raw: DogeOS launched a public testnet for its zero-knowledge rollup bringing EVM smart contracts to Dogecoin, with DOGE used for gas fees.
